issues.title: Missing Acceptance Criteria for Core Logic
issues.why: While the Overview (00) has one AC for cross-links, the actual logic modules (01, 02, 03) lack GWT criteria for their specific behaviors (e.g., version bumping rules, error wrapping logic).
issues.fix: Add a 97-acceptance-criteria.md file to each sub-module with GWT scenarios for its specific logic.

issues.title: Unresolved External Script References
issues.why: The spec references numerous scripts (e.g., check-spec-cross-links.py, sync-version.mjs) and files (package.json) that are not provided in the context, making it impossible to verify their interface.
issues.fix: Include the CLI help output or interface definitions for all referenced linter and sync scripts in a 'Tooling' section.

issues.title: Concurrency and Large Input Omissions
issues.why: The coding guidelines (02) and error management (03) do not explicitly address concurrency safety (e.g., Go routine leaks) or handling of extremely large JSON payloads in the envelope.
issues.fix: Add a 'Resource Constraints' section to 02-coding-guidelines.md addressing concurrency and payload limits.
